what: The line beside the vertical year rows, like a timeline, grows with scroll. The line end always sits 20% of the screen above the bottom edge of the screen and stops 5px before the last dot. A dot lights up (is-active, color set in the user’s css) once the bottom edge of the screen passes the dot’s top edge + 30% of the screen. No curve, tied directly to scroll

options.lead: Share of the line where its end sits above the bottom edge of the screen (in screen heights), default .2
options.on: Where dots light up — when the screen bottom drops below the dot top by this share, default .3
options.stop: Distance (px) to stop before the top edge of the last dot, default 5
options.--fx-x: Line horizontal position (via style), default 0 — 50% for a centered timeline
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Growing line (child, empty span) — the base line is set separately by the consumer
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Dot (child) to light up — gets is-active when passed

from.where: about.html timeline (.ab-line — center line, dots turn orange when lit) — original .js-progress-line · .js-line-circle
